outing.hero_prompt_english: TANKO Tangu in Mentougou: a compact contemporary pedestrian district at the foot of western hills, warm-toned low modern facades, stepped terraces, planters and a public plaza with cafe tables. Two adult friends read and drink coffee below mountain silhouettes. Authentic mountain-foot slow-life atmosphere with compact human-scale urban architecture, no fictional alpine chalets. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
